# Environment asset credits

All third-party environment assets used by the level are **CC0 1.0 (public domain)**. Attribution is not required; it is given here anyway.

| File(s) | Source | Author | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assets/env/city_night_1k.hdr` | [Vignaioli Night HDRI](https://polyhaven.com/a/vignaioli_night) | Poly Haven (Greg Zaal; backplates Rico Cilliers) | CC0 1.0 |
| `assets/tex/asphalt_color.jpg`, `asphalt_normal.jpg`, `asphalt_rough.jpg` | [Asphalt025C](https://ambientcg.com/a/Asphalt025C) | ambientCG (Lennart Demes) | CC0 1.0 |
| `assets/tex/sidewalk_color.jpg`, `sidewalk_normal.jpg`, `sidewalk_rough.jpg` | [Tiles038](https://ambientcg.com/a/Tiles038) | ambientCG (Lennart Demes) | CC0 1.0 |
| `assets/tex/concrete_color.jpg`, `concrete_normal.jpg`, `concrete_rough.jpg` | [Concrete034](https://ambientcg.com/a/Concrete034) | ambientCG (Lennart Demes) | CC0 1.0 |

Textures were downscaled / re-encoded for the web. License references:
[Poly Haven license](https://polyhaven.com/license) · [ambientCG license](https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/).

Everything else in the city (buildings, windows, shop signs and their artwork, billboards, bus stops, street furniture, cranes, containers, water, sky) is generated procedurally in code (`src/world/`).
